notes.goal: Build a complete composed bridge-convoy passage ending at the east doorway with the reusable blue block surviving.
notes.change: Create an independent lower access pocket, north gate and side storage, supported turning bay, and east bridge followed by a final gate.
notes.reason: The first floor unlocks the reusable blocker. The blocker gives access to the retained floor; staging restores a northbound pair, then separate translations create an eastbound floor-first convoy. The blue must perform another gate crossing after the retained floor is consumed.
expectedChecks: Full supported route to the doorway
Consumable budget and live blue after delivery
Finite exclusions for bridge use and blue directional reuse

notes.label: Agent design annotation
notes.change: Separate storage from the turning bay with a single-cell gate and supported staging on each side; extend the northbound transport before the turn.
notes.reason: The first verification found a complete solution without a northbound joint push. The new gate makes sending one tool ahead leave the other behind a boundary the player cannot freely recross. Both tools must be recovered into a chain to reach the useful turning bay.
expectedChecks: Exhaustive exclusion of solutions without northbound joint transport
Ordered joint transport before retained-floor consumption
Matched gate and bridge-order branch controls

notes.label: Complete Reserve and Relay at the east doorway with blue surviving.
notes.goal: Complete Reserve and Relay at the east doorway with blue surviving.
notes.change: Final room and formal report retained without further map changes. Saved a real 48-input browser playthrough with 49 independently checked actor frames.
notes.reason: The final shared verifier passes eight finite exclusions and two reachable branch controls. The previous layout allowed a convoy bypass and remains preserved. The original case independently replays all 177 inputs and three local controls after using its official room lookup. The strict packaged reference CLI cannot inspect Git metadata in the supplied tracked-file engine copy; its map differs only by CRLF line endings. An earlier supplemental audit failed before writing its requested report, and this diagnostic history remains preserved.
expectedChecks: Publish the matching build-02 manifest and test-02 verification
Retain the actual browser replay and all previous failures
Report publication audit or deployment failures without bypassing them
